title: 建立机器可读的组件唯一职权矩阵
scope: Static machine-readable component authority manifest and tests only; no runtime wiring or product default change.

component.benefitEvidence: Unique authority keys=38; domains=10; sourceAnchors=37; no runtime import.
component.rollback: Remove the manifest/test/doc change and Task Forest proposal; no runtime rollback is needed.
component.modelEffectiveState: Defined via buildComponentAuthorityProfile; not wired into live model behavior by this node.

acceptanceResults.criterion: 所有现有组件至少映射到一个 authority domain
acceptanceResults.observation: 34 components map to 10 authority domains; validator reports no unowned domains.

acceptanceResults.criterion: 同一 data type + scope + operation 没有两个 accepting/update writer；不同数据域允许不同 store
acceptanceResults.observation: 38 assignments use unique dataType+scope+operation keys; role-card, runtime-fact/timeline/episode, candidate and embedding stores remain distinct.

acceptanceResults.criterion: 存在自动测试拒绝第二个 accepted-memory writer、第二 context assembly owner、第二 domain executor 和权限扩大
acceptanceResults.observation: Negative tests reject a second accepted-memory writer, second context assembly owner, second domain executor, permission escalation and unauthorized cross-domain writes.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Context/Memory/Knowledge/Capability/Execution/Browser/Observability 冲突边界都有架构测试或静态 guard
acceptanceResults.observation: Context, Memory, Knowledge, Capability, Execution, Permission, Task, Browser, Observability and UI transport each have explicit ownership and static guard assertions.

acceptanceResults.criterion: manifest 与 product semantics/default config 交叉检查通过
acceptanceResults.observation: Cross-check links cover 10 product-surface rows and 11 default-matrix rows; default cells and FP-P1 labels match baseline hashes.

limitations: TF-0490 ComponentGraduationReport/v1 validator does not exist yet; this is a decision-level prefix.
The manifest is deliberately not imported by runtime behavior; TF-0489 proves structure and static ownership, not live effective state.
No product default, product lock, public release, GA, liveReady or productApproved state is changed.
New authority/evidence files under docs are currently local-only under the repository retention block; manifest/index landing is outside TF-0489 allowed paths.
